name: Travel Claim Report
query:
SELECT
  ec.company AS `Company Name:Link/Company:160`,
  emp.branch AS `Branch Name:Link/Branch:110`,
  ec.name AS `Voucher No:Link/Expense Claim:150`,
  ec.posting_date AS `Voucher Date:Date:100`,
  ec.employee_name AS `Travel Employee Name:Data:170`,
  ec.custom_travel_type AS `Vehicle Type:Link/Travel Type:110`,
  ec.custom_travel_purpose AS `Travel Purpose:Data:120`,
  ec.custom_per_km_rate AS `Per KM Rate:Currency:90`,
  ec.custom_from_date AS `From Date:Date:100`,
  ec.custom_to_date AS `To Date:Date:100`,
  ec.custom_from_location AS `From Location:Data:130`,
  ec.custom_to_location AS `To Location:Data:130`,
  ec.remark AS `Description:Data:180`,
  ec.custom_total_km AS `Total KM:Float:80`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Conveyance (KM)' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS `Total KM Amount:Currency:110`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Conveyance (KM)' AND IFNULL(d.custom_bill, '') != '' THEN CONCAT('=HYPERLINK("', IF(LEFT(d.custom_bill, 4) = 'http', d.custom_bill, CONCAT('https://brainmineai.in', d.custom_bill)), '","Open")') END) AS `Total KM Path Link:Data:100`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Transport' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS `Transport:Currency:100`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Transport' AND IFNULL(d.custom_bill, '') != '' THEN CONCAT('=HYPERLINK("', IF(LEFT(d.custom_bill, 4) = 'http', d.custom_bill, CONCAT('https://brainmineai.in', d.custom_bill)), '","Open")') END) AS `Transport Path Link:Data:100`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Food' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS `Food:Currency:90`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Food' AND IFNULL(d.custom_bill, '') != '' THEN CONCAT('=HYPERLINK("', IF(LEFT(d.custom_bill, 4) = 'http', d.custom_bill, CONCAT('https://brainmineai.in', d.custom_bill)), '","Open")') END) AS `Food Path Link:Data:100`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Hotel' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS `Hotel:Currency:90`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Hotel' AND IFNULL(d.custom_bill, '') != '' THEN CONCAT('=HYPERLINK("', IF(LEFT(d.custom_bill, 4) = 'http', d.custom_bill, CONCAT('https://brainmineai.in', d.custom_bill)), '","Open")') END) AS `Hotel Path Link:Data:100`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Local Conveyance' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS `Conveyance:Currency:100`,
  GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Local Conveyance' THEN d.description END SEPARATOR '; ') AS `Conveyance Remark:Data:200`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Local Conveyance' AND IFNULL(d.custom_bill, '') != '' THEN CONCAT('=HYPERLINK("', IF(LEFT(d.custom_bill, 4) = 'http', d.custom_bill, CONCAT('https://brainmineai.in', d.custom_bill)), '","Open")') END) AS `Conveyance Path Link:Data:100`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Other A' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS `Other A:Currency:90`,
  GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Other A' THEN d.description END SEPARATOR '; ') AS `Other A Remark:Data:200`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Other A' AND IFNULL(d.custom_bill, '') != '' THEN CONCAT('=HYPERLINK("', IF(LEFT(d.custom_bill, 4) = 'http', d.custom_bill, CONCAT('https://brainmineai.in', d.custom_bill)), '","Open")') END) AS `Other A Path Link:Data:100`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Other B' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS `Other B:Currency:90`,
  GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Other B' THEN d.description END SEPARATOR '; ') AS `Other B Remark:Data:200`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.expense_type = 'Other B' AND IFNULL(d.custom_bill, '') != '' THEN CONCAT('=HYPERLINK("', IF(LEFT(d.custom_bill, 4) = 'http', d.custom_bill, CONCAT('https://brainmineai.in', d.custom_bill)), '","Open")') END) AS `Other B Path Link:Data:100`,
  ec.total_claimed_amount AS `Total Amount:Currency:110`,
  ec.total_sanctioned_amount AS `Approved Amount:Currency:110`,
  ec.status AS `Status:Data:120`,
  ec.expense_approver AS `Approve/Reject By:Link/User:150`,
  ec.modified AS `Approve/Reject Date:Datetime:150`
FROM `tabExpense Claim` ec
LEFT JOIN `tabExpense Claim Detail` d
  ON d.parent = ec.name AND d.parenttype = 'Expense Claim'
LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` emp
  ON emp.name = ec.employee
WHERE ec.docstatus < 2
  AND ec.company = %(company)s
  AND ec.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY ec.name
ORDER BY ec.posting_date DESC, ec.name DESC
